messages:
Alex R: Starting thread — need to align on audit log export workflows and per-tenant retention options for SOC2 launch. High level ask from product: per-customer retention windows, export API, and KMS-backed archives.
Maya S: +1. Are we targeting per-tenant keys or a single org-level HSM initially?
Samir K: Prefer single KMS support at launch. Per-tenant keying adds complexity to rotation + billing. We can add later.
Leigh (Legal): SOC2 evidence requirements: must retain certain audit events for 2 years minimum; some legal holds require up to 7 years. Need configurable retention per-customer for enterprise contracts.
Jordan (PM): From roadmap POV, Q4 goal is 'SOC2 evidence export + 90/365 retention tiers'. Can we scope an MVP with 90/365 and a manual export feature?
Alex R: Proposal: MVP = export API + admin console retention setting with three presets (90, 365, indefinite-request). No per-tenant KMS — use customer-managed KMS only for Private deployments. Hosted customers use Redwood-managed KMS with HSM-backed keystore.
Maya S: Implementation notes: backend needs export job orchestration, S3-compatible archive, signed manifests, and immutable audit trail. Also per-tenant rate limits for export jobs.
Samir K: Draft of API:
```
POST /v1/audit_exports
{ "tenant_id":"t_123", "start":"2025-01-01", "end":"2025-06-30", "format":"ndjson", "destination": {"s3_bucket":"arn:aws:s3:::example-bucket","role":"arn:aws:iam::123:role/ExportRole"} }
```
Response: 202 with job id and presigned manifest.
Jordan (PM): Launch criteria suggestion: 1) Exports complete with checksum verification, 2) Retention setting visible in Console + audit trail for changes, 3) Compliance docs updated + SOC2 readiness checklist, 4) 2 pilot customers validated end-to-end.
Leigh (Legal): Also need legal hold API for eDiscovery: preserve data beyond retention until explicit release. That must be auditable.
Maya S: We need infra cost estimate for storing 365 days of logs per high-volume tenant. @Samir K can you do a back-of-envelope?
Samir K: Rough calc: avg 10GB/day/tenant -> ~3.6TB/year -> S3 cost ~$80/mo + retrieval costs. Storage looks OK for pilot but will be significant at scale. Suggest lifecycle policy to Glacier for >90 days.
Alex R: Open engineering questions: a) retention enforcement granularity (day vs hour), b) deletion proof for audits (soft delete + tombstone + retention flag), c) encryption-at-rest per-tenant vs org level.
Jordan (PM): Action items: Samir - prototype export job + S3 manifest (ETA EOW). Maya - update Console wireframe for retention presets. Leigh - draft legal retention table and legal-hold API requirements. I'll schedule a customer sync with 2 large customers for feedback.
compliance-bot: Reminder: next SOC2 pre-audit in 30 days. Please tag evidence PRs to #incidents.
Maya S: Noted. I'll post wireframes by Tue.
Samir K: Prototype ETA Friday. Will need 2 engineers for 1 sprint to harden and add checksums.
Alex R: Decision for now: MVP as discussed. No per-tenant KMS in hosted. Revisit after telemetry and customer ask. :thumbsup: 
Jordan (PM): Thanks all — I'll add this to the Q4 roadmap and OKR draft unless anyone objects.
Leigh (Legal): No objections from legal side. Please include legal-hold API in scope for enterprise GA.
Alex R: Great; closing thread. Ping here with any blocking items.
